item.title: Getting 25 Gbps Thunderbolt Ethernet on My Mac Studio
item.description:
📝 I stopped looking until I saw this blog post. Christian Kohlschütter found a cheap 25G Thunderbolt adapter that uses a server-pulled OCP 2 NIC with a little Thunderbolt 3 adapter board. And it works on any computer with Thunderbolt.
🔗 Read more: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2026/getting-25g-ethernet-mac-thunderbolt/

item.title: Everyone is building LLM routers, we deprecated ours
item.description:
📝 We don’t believe in model routing anymore. Recently, there’s been huge hype around AI model routers that select the model that will respond to your request on the fly. A cache-aware model router will take that into account by adding stickiness to the initially chosen model and keeps querying it.
🔗 Read more: https://manifest.build/blog/why-we-deprecated-our-llm-router/

item.title: Run Kimi K3 using 29 GB of RAM at 0.50 tok/s
item.description:
📝 7 tok/s WASTE was written for that one model and that one constraint: K3 does not fit in the RAM of current mainstream consumer systems. What that opens up, concretely: a frontier-scale model that answers with no network, no per-token invoice, and nothing leaving the machine — which is the difference between "you may not send that data to an API" and "run it here". WASTE means to be the first concrete step toward ending that waste of tokens.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/sqliteai/waste
